name: Journey to Horizon: Rumors (d100)
description: A hook for a region. It could be any mixture of true or false—you decide, and you decide whether anyone in the party is aware of it.

results.name: Rumor 01
results.description: Dire fauna and carnivorous flora two or three times their normal size live here.

results.name: Rumor 02
results.description: A black obelisk hums with the sorrowful voices of missing travelers.

results.name: Rumor 03
results.description: A beast of bone and shadow stalks old ruins, calling out in the voice of a child.

results.name: Rumor 04
results.description: A village that once burned down reappears in the light of the full moon.

results.name: Rumor 05
results.description: A ruined wizard’s tower holds books about the long-ago, the never-was, and the soon-to-be.

results.name: Rumor 06
results.description: Geysers of wild magic erupt arrhythmically—random effects surge when spells are cast nearby.

results.name: Rumor 07
results.description: A caravan travels an endless circuit, trading memories instead of coin.

results.name: Rumor 08
results.description: The local wildlife knows the secret and safe pathways through this region.

results.name: Rumor 09
results.description: A crystal canyon hums with unstable psychic reverberations, invading dreams with unwanted visions.

results.name: Rumor 10
results.description: A shadowblighted knight challenges travelers to mortal combat. His curse is laid on whomever slays him.

results.name: Rumor 11
results.description: A bell tolls at midnight, though no source can be found.

results.name: Rumor 12
results.description: Lights flicker in the windows of a drowned city.

results.name: Rumor 13
results.description: A broken bridge leads to another time.

results.name: Rumor 14
results.description: A harpist made of light appears at a crossroads and demands a song in exchange for safe passage.

results.name: Rumor 15
results.description: A storm of shadowblight hunts travelers like a thinking beast.

results.name: Rumor 16
results.description: The earthquakes here are echoes of a chained giant’s nightmares.

results.name: Rumor 17
results.description: A storm of embers perpetually drifts overhead.

results.name: Rumor 18
results.description: A ring of laughing mushrooms shares secrets with anyone brave enough to enter it.

results.name: Rumor 19
results.description: Everything here appears translucent, as though only half real.

results.name: Rumor 20
results.description: Travelers hear lullabies sung by unseen mothers.

results.name: Rumor 21
results.description: A cloaked figure pays gold for tales of grief—no one knows why.

results.name: Rumor 22
results.description: A sword of living fire fell into the earth here. No one has yet been strong enough to pull it from the ground.

results.name: Rumor 23
results.description: A new caravan route allows trade and safety in numbers.

results.name: Rumor 24
results.description: Invisible, impenetrable barriers turn the landscape into a labyrinth.

results.name: Rumor 25
results.description: Within a canyon, gravity fluctuates and inverts itself unpredictably.

results.name: Rumor 26
results.description: A spring bubbles with ink that heals wounds but permanently stains anything it touches.

results.name: Rumor 27
results.description: A living cavern tempts passersby with tales of treasure within.

results.name: Rumor 28
results.description: A constellation of ghostly lanterns floats through the air in mesmerizing patterns.

results.name: Rumor 29
results.description: A mage’s tomb wanders the land on giant mechanical legs.

results.name: Rumor 30
results.description: Cracks in the sky show a different set of stars.

results.name: Rumor 31
results.description: A hunter claims to know a cure for shadowblight but asks a dangerous favor in exchange for it.

results.name: Rumor 32
results.description: Oversized fruits and vegetables offer an abundance of food to be foraged.

results.name: Rumor 33
results.description: Spectral armies made of clouds wage war in the sky.

results.name: Rumor 34
results.description: The earth bleeds when wounded by picks or plows.

results.name: Rumor 35
results.description: A quartz tower splits the light of dawn into separate bands of color.

results.name: Rumor 36
results.description: A bridge of spider silk spans a bottomless chasm.

results.name: Rumor 37
results.description: The friendly hermit who lives here knows when others will die.

results.name: Rumor 38
results.description: The blood-red lake is filled with eels who grant wishes—that those who make them come to regret.

results.name: Rumor 39
results.description: A curse of magical silence befell this place.

results.name: Rumor 40
results.description: A candle here burned through the Long Sorrow, and burns still.

results.name: Rumor 41
results.description: A castle made of bone appears only at twilight.

results.name: Rumor 42
results.description: Every night, a shadowblighted battlefield vomits forth undead armies to fight each other.

results.name: Rumor 43
results.description: A tree with the face of a man knows the secret weakness of every living thing.

results.name: Rumor 44
results.description: A city has been locked in magical slumber since before the sanctuary walls came down.

results.name: Rumor 45
results.description: A ghost ship sails across land instead of sea.

results.name: Rumor 46
results.description: A lost friend, relative, or companion was supposedly seen here.

results.name: Rumor 47
results.description: A meteor fell to earth and cracked open, leaking strange life.

results.name: Rumor 48
results.description: A field of magnetic stone holds fast anything metal.

results.name: Rumor 49
results.description: An enormous clockwork machine lies half-buried.

results.name: Rumor 50
results.description: Faceless merchants run shadow-markets.

results.name: Rumor 51
results.description: A child of glass wanders the wastes, seeking their missing parents.

results.name: Rumor 52
results.description: A labyrinth of brambles regrows behind travelers.

results.name: Rumor 53
results.description: A village celebrates births with coffins, not cradles.

results.name: Rumor 54
results.description: There is a shortcut here not found on any map.

results.name: Rumor 55
results.description: A dragon’s hoard remains mysteriously undisturbed, though the dragon hasn’t been seen since the sanctuaries opened.

results.name: Rumor 56
results.description: A tower grows steadily taller each morning despite no sign of builders.

results.name: Rumor 57
results.description: Weapons can’t be drawn here.

results.name: Rumor 58
results.description: These lands hold evidence of an enemy’s weakness.

results.name: Rumor 59
results.description: Alchemists come from far-off lands for this region’s rare herbs, minerals, and other components.

results.name: Rumor 60
results.description: Schools of goldfish swim through the air.

results.name: Rumor 61
results.description: A blind shepherd tends to flocks of shadows instead of sheep.

results.name: Rumor 62
results.description: Fire burns cold and blue here.

results.name: Rumor 63
results.description: The path is protected by wards forged by a nameless saint.

results.name: Rumor 64
results.description: A gallery of stone figures stands, each a thousand feet tall.

results.name: Rumor 65
results.description: A black sun traces its course across the sky every hour.

results.name: Rumor 66
results.description: A bridge of flesh groans and sighs beneath travelers’ weight.

results.name: Rumor 67
results.description: A tree bleeds golden sap that hardens into cursed jewels.

results.name: Rumor 68
results.description: A chained serpent begs for release.

results.name: Rumor 69
results.description: The trees uproot themselves and walk around at night.

results.name: Rumor 70
results.description: A chained door built into the ground in the middle of nowhere rattles at night. No one knows what’s trapped behind it.

results.name: Rumor 71
results.description: Ancient ruins offer shelter and salvageable relics.

results.name: Rumor 72
results.description: A spectral orchestra plays in a ruined amphitheater.

results.name: Rumor 73
results.description: A storm of crystal shards scours the land clean as it drifts.

results.name: Rumor 74
results.description: A child living here claims to have memories of Old Valloren.

results.name: Rumor 75
results.description: A cemetery grows larger each night.

results.name: Rumor 76
results.description: The moon weeps silver droplets that burn the ground.

results.name: Rumor 77
results.description: A warrior in golden armor battles never-ending waves of shadowblighted beasts.

results.name: Rumor 78
results.description: A songbird guards a nest filled with magic rings.

results.name: Rumor 79
results.description: A ruined temple drags travelers into its dreams.

results.name: Rumor 80
results.description: A rainbow hums with power. Some claim it can be walked on.

results.name: Rumor 81
results.description: Two doors stand side by side: one leads to wealth beyond measure, the other to certain doom. No one knows which is which.

results.name: Rumor 82
results.description: The road vanishes behind travelers as they walk it.

results.name: Rumor 83
results.description: A ruin of shattered glass offers windows into other realms.

results.name: Rumor 84
results.description: A mountain floats high above the ground, green lightning striking its peak.

results.name: Rumor 85
results.description: A mysterious hunter born from the land ambushes trespassers with living arrows.

results.name: Rumor 86
results.description: A river of liquid light runs through here.

results.name: Rumor 87
results.description: A colossus sleeps here, often mistaken for a mountain.

results.name: Rumor 88
results.description: A plague of paper-eating butterflies terrorizes this region.

results.name: Rumor 89
results.description: A gargantuan skeleton carved with runes sprawls across the landscape.

results.name: Rumor 90
results.description: A cursed shrine answers any question in exchange for a year of life.

results.name: Rumor 91
results.description: A never-ending storm carries the voices of drowned sailors.

results.name: Rumor 92
results.description: The flowers here bloom in response to the goddess Aurelia’s name.

results.name: Rumor 93
results.description: A herd of luminous beasts crosses the land in silence.

results.name: Rumor 94
results.description: A meadow of glass flowers rings in the wind. If its music can be deciphered, it tells the future.

results.name: Rumor 95
results.description: Soldiers made of sand appear in the morning but crumble when touched.

results.name: Rumor 96
results.description: A tree bears glowing fruit that changes the age of anyone who consumes it.

results.name: Rumor 97
results.description: A pool of tears cried by an Aurelian saint heals wounds but deepens despair.

results.name: Rumor 98
results.description: A crown of ice lies within a frozen palace and whispers promises of conquest.

results.name: Rumor 99
results.description: A lone cottage stands with shadowblight trailing out of its chimney and into the sky.

results.name: Rumor 00
results.description: A comet hangs in the sky but never falls. Rival religious groups argue about its meaning.
